verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents Kong's CLIs (decK, kongctl), Admin API, Terraform providers, and a Konnect MCP Server, but none of it shows a first-party natural-language interface for operating Kong. The MCP server entry is only a page title, and serving tools to external agents belongs to a separate MCP-server story, so it cannot be credited here. The AI Gateway features proxy LLM traffic rather than taking natural-language commands to operate the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
